system.effect:
Requirement: An active compatible modular item with one empty mount.

Displacement (EC14)

REACTION • Burn 2 • USES 1 • RESOURCE 0

Resolution: Automatic; burn the printed dice

Range / Targeting: 3 units / Self or one willing ally

Trigger: Another character declares an Action targeting the protected creature; use before that Action is rolled or resolved.

Effect: The protected creature cannot be affected by the triggering Action. This explicitly prevents that Action’s effects against that creature; its other targets and independent effects resolve normally. After the Action finishes, the protected creature may teleport to an unoccupied space it can see within 2 units of itself.

Design note: Cancels effects against one creature, not the entire Action. Does not protect against separate nested Actions or Reactions, existing hazards, or later attacks.
system.flavor: An exceptional one-use answer to a declared attack.
